description: For a unary function symbol \(f\), the equations \(x_0\doteq f(x_1)\) and \(x_1\doteq f(x_0)\) have no finite-term unifier.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.cyclic_no_solution.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (f : L.Functions 1) {α : Type w}
  (σ : ℕ → L.Term α) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies σ
      [(FirstOrder.Language.var 0, Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.unary f (FirstOrder.Language.var 1)),
        (FirstOrder.Language.var 1, Lemmatheca.Entry.TermUnification.unary f (FirstOrder.Language.var 0))]
